note: Summary. The authoritative byte-level examples are backend/tests/fixtures/native_effect_wire_v1.json (written by NativeEffectFlowSelfTest, replayed by test_cplus_wn_java_wire.py).
canonical_json: sorted keys, separators (',',':'), ASCII only: everything outside 0x20..0x7e is \u-escaped (including DEL 0x7f); identical in Java and Python

claims.block: exclusive per (world, dimension, x, y, z)
claims.item: entity uuid, plus same item_key within 2.0 horizontal / 1.0 vertical

rules: Forge may dispatch the native call only after the START reply that echoes task_id, attempt_id, world_id, actor_id, session_id
retries resend identical bytes; a changed payload under the same request_id is refused
status is answered per attempt with the exact identity and receipt_hash; another actor's latest terminal is never adopted
an HTTP ACK never claims world durability (applied in memory / recorded locally / backend-confirmed / world-persisted are distinct)
